name: academic-research-skills
description: Academic Research Skills for Claude Code: research → write → review → revise → finalize
one_liner: A step-by-step AI toolkit that walks a researcher through an entire academic paper: researching the topic, writing the draft, reviewing it, revising it, and finalizing it for submission.
buyer: A PhD student or early-career researcher juggling multiple papers who wants to speed up the mechanical parts of writing (structure, citations, revision passes) without sacrificing rigor.
business_use_cases: A PhD student uses it to move from literature review to a submission-ready draft faster across multiple papers.
A university writing center offers it as a supported tool in workshops for graduate students learning academic writing.
A research consultancy uses it to help non-native-English-speaking academics produce publication-ready manuscripts.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI-assisted paper coaching' service for grad students, using this toolkit plus human review as the deliverable.
License a customized version to university writing centers as part of their student support subscription.

steal_this: This weekend, offer three PhD students a free trial run on a real paper draft, collect feedback, then turn it into a paid coaching package.
